name: POS Fix Discount
description: This app will enable order-based discounts instead of product-based either in the percentage or in amount. Till now with default functionality, users can only apply discounts on products which can be time-consuming.
summary: The POS Order Discount module for Odoo allows you to apply discounts on the entire order instead of individual products. Discounts can be applied either as a percentage or a fixed amount, saving time and simplifying the checkout process. This feature streamlines discount management and improves efficiency for businesses running Odoo POS. Simplify discount management in your Odoo Point of Sale with the POS Fix Discount Module. By default, Odoo only supports product-level discounts, which can be time-consuming for cashiers. This module enhances the checkout experience by allowing order-level discounts, enabling staff to apply discounts to the entire order either as a percentage or a fixed amount. With its intuitive interface, cashiers can apply discounts quickly and accurately, ensuring a faster checkout and a smoother sales process. Whether used for promotions, loyalty rewards, or special offers, this module eliminates repetitive work and provides a flexible discounting solution for your business. Seamlessly integrated into Odoo POS, it boosts sales efficiency, reduces errors, and improves customer satisfaction, making it ideal for retail stores, supermarkets, and restaurants. name: POS Global Suggested Product
description: The Global Product Suggestions feature for the Point of Sale system empowers businesses to increase sales by displaying a curated list of suggested products during the checkout process. These products are strategically selected and shown on the payment screen, allowing sales associates to offer additional items to customers as they complete their purchase.
summary: The Global Product Suggestions feature for the Point of Sale system is designed to enhance the sales process by strategically displaying a curated list of recommended products to customers during checkout. These suggestions are tailored to encourage sales associates to offer complementary or additional items, increasing the likelihood of upselling or cross-selling. By incorporating these suggested products on the POS payment screen, businesses can enhance the customer experience by making relevant recommendations in real time. This feature is especially valuable in retail environments, restaurants, and service industries where customers may be interested in adding related items or services. As a result, businesses can increase their average order value, streamline the purchasing process, and ultimately drive more sales while providing a more personalized shopping experience. name: POS Cart Item Count
description: This add on automatically calculates and displays the total number of items in the current order both on the POS screen and on printed customer receipts.
summary: The POS Item Count Module for Odoo automatically calculates and displays the total number of items in the current order, both on the POS screen and on printed customer receipts. This simple yet effective add-on helps cashiers process transactions more efficiently and with fewer errors. It seamlessly integrates with the Odoo POS system, making it an ideal solution for retail stores, cafes, restaurants, and supermarkets. The POS Item Count Module for Odoo is a valuable extension designed to enhance the functionality of the Odoo Point of Sale (POS) system. This module adds a simple yet essential feature: it automatically calculates and displays the total number of items in the current order in real-time, both on the POS screen and on printed customer receipts. Perfect for retail stores, supermarkets, cafes, and restaurants, this lightweight add-on seamlessly integrates with the existing Odoo POS framework, requiring no additional configuration after installation. By showing the total item count during the transaction, this module helps cashiers work more efficiently and accurately, reducing errors in order processing. The POS Item Count Module not only benefits cashiers by improving the checkout process but also enhances customer satisfaction. Printed receipts now show the total number of items in the order, providing customers with clearer information about their purchases. name: POS Membership Card
description: With the help of this app, The user can create the category of cards such as gold or silver and can define category-based discounts so whenever such customer shows his card to the cashier he will get a discount on the whole order based on his category.
summary: This app lets you create customer card categories such as Gold or Silver and set category-based discounts. When a customer presents their card, the system automatically applies the discount to their entire order based on their category.
